description: Create a new note. Returns its id. Never use em dashes or en dashes in anything written to a note. Use a period, colon, comma, or parentheses instead. Ordinary hyphens in compound words and numeric ranges are fine.

folder_id.description: Optional folder id to file the note in, as returned by list_folders. Omit to leave it in Uncategorized.

markdown.description: The complete body of the new note in Markdown. The first line becomes the title, exactly as it does when typing into the editor.

name: scratchpad_create_note
title: Create note
